rich_description: The ChildCare Subsidy (CCS) and Infant Care Subsidy (ICS) reduce the monthly fees that families pay at MSF-licensed childcare centres (for children 18 months to before age 7) and infant care centres (for children 2 to 18 months). Every Singapore citizen child gets a flat Basic Subsidy regardless of family income, but the much larger Additional Subsidy goes to families where the mother works at least 56 hours a month and gross monthly household income is at or below $12,000. The lower the income, the higher the subsidy — at the bottom income tier, families can pay as little as $3 a month for full-day childcare at an Anchor Operator centre. Non-working mothers also qualify for Basic Subsidy but at a much lower rate. The subsidy is applied directly at the centre — parents pay only the net fee. Tampines has many MSF-licensed preschools; if your child is a Singapore citizen and household income is tight, going to a Anchor Operator (PCF Sparkletots, My First Skool) centre maximises both the subsidy and the cap on monthly fees.

other_criteria: Child must be a Singapore citizen aged 2-18 months (Infant Care) or 18 months to before age 7 (Childcare)
Child must be enrolled at an MSF-licensed centre
Working Mother definition: at least 56 working hours per month for Additional Subsidy
Additional Subsidy tiered by household income — maximum at gross monthly income ≤ $3,000, tapering until $12,000
Basic Subsidy paid to all Singapore citizen children regardless of mother's working status, but at a lower rate for non-working mothers

required_documents.name: Child's birth certificate
required_documents.notes: To confirm citizenship and date of birth

required_documents.name: Mother's CPF contribution history
required_documents.notes: To verify working hours for Additional Subsidy

oth_location: Apply via the LifeSG app or directly at the chosen MSF-licensed preschool — the centre submits on behalf of the family. ServiceSG counter at OTH can help with login if the family is unfamiliar with the app. PLACEHOLDER — verify ECDA enquiry counter presence at OTH.
typical_processing_time: Subsidy approval typically 2-4 weeks from complete submission. Once approved, applied as a direct fee reduction from the following month onwards.
